title: Execution Stage v0.1
description: The machine's one authoritative crypto execution stage (Thomas decisions 1, 4, 8, 9, 2026-09-15; docs/runtime-contracts/EXECUTION_STAGE_V0.1.md). A self-hashed record bound to the policy version and the policy's safety semantic fingerprint under which it was approved, witnessed by the Thomas-verified CONSUMED approval whose content it carries. No stage expires. A missing, unreadable, tampered, unwitnessed or unbound record reads as READ_ONLY. Registering a stage opens no door by itself: the entry doors read it (PR1b) beside every gate they already apply.

transition.description: BOOTSTRAP: a record at SHADOW or PAPER when no stage above READ_ONLY binds, approved and attested. CLIMB: exactly one rung up from a binding record, approved. REBIND: the same rung, approved, only after a policy change. DEMOTE: any rung down, no approval; it carries the approval it descends from (none when it lands on READ_ONLY).

witness_stage_id.description: The stage_id the witnessing approval's CONSUMED record points at: this record's own for BOOTSTRAP/CLIMB/REBIND, the approved record it descends from for a DEMOTE, null for a DEMOTE to READ_ONLY.

policy_version.description: Null only on a DEMOTE to READ_ONLY written while the policy could not be read.

testnet_cycle_id.description: The signed testnet cycle this LIVE_AUTONOMOUS record stands on (PR1d-2). Required at that rung; refused at every other.
